observations: Three photos show a large flat-screen TV on a stand, displaying a smart TV interface with app icons like BBC News, Netflix, YouTube, and others.
The screen is bright and appears to be on, showing a home screen with content categories like 'New & Trending' and 'Family Favourites'.
The TV has a slim black bezel and is supported by two short, angled black legs.
A black soundbar is placed in front of the TV on the floor in all photos.
The background shows a tiled floor and other electronics or furniture, suggesting a home or showroom setting.
No brand or model is visible on the front or bezel in any photo.
The screen displays a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ENOCHBIZ' across the center.

claims.claim: UK used Samsung 55 inches RU series UHD 4k smart TV
claims.evidence: No brand or model visible in any photo. The screen shows a smart interface, but Samsung cannot be confirmed visually.
No visible ports, settings menu, or interface details to confirm Bluetooth or AirPlay. These features cannot be verified from photos alone.

risks.proof: Photo showing the brand and model name on the front bezel, back panel, or settings menu.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 55 inch smart TV, not as a Samsung RU series.

risks.risk: TV does not support UHD 4K resolution or smart features like Bluetooth and AirPlay

risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-4K or non-smart TV, with reduced value.

risks.risk: Physical damage or screen defects not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the screen edges, bezel, and back panel, and a video showing the screen under different lighting to check for dead pixels or burn-in.

proof_requests: Photo of the TV's back panel or front bezel showing the brand and model name.
Screenshot or video of the TV's settings menu showing resolution, Bluetooth, and AirPlay options.
Close-up photos of the screen and bezel to check for damage or defects.
response.reason: The brand and model cannot be confirmed from the photos, and key features like Bluetooth and AirPlay are unverifiable. Without proof of identity and functionality, the item cannot be priced accurately.
